landingPage.heroDescription: A single-page site for a cleaning business that shows an upfront, itemized price as visitors choose their rooms and how often they want a clean.
landingPage.about: Quote Slider is a single-page website for a residential cleaning service that wants to show prices upfront instead of hiding them behind a contact form. Visitors move bedroom and bathroom sliders, choose how often they want a clean, and watch the visit price and the itemized maths update instantly, including any repeat-visit discount. The estimate is clearly marked as a guide, not a binding price. Each quote lives in the page address, so visitors can share it, print a one-page summary or send it to you by email. Your base price, per-room rates and discounts sit in one data file. It is built with Astro and TypeScript and deploys from GitHub to Hostinger.

features.title: Live quote builder
features.description: Bedroom, bathroom and frequency controls update the visit price as visitors adjust them.

features.title: Transparent pricing
features.description: Base price, per-room rates and repeat-visit discounts are shown line by line.

features.title: Shareable quotes
features.description: Every estimate is saved in the page address, so it survives a reload and can be shared.

features.title: Print and email handoff
features.description: Visitors print a one-page quote or send it to you in a prefilled email.

features.title: Clearly non-binding
features.description: The estimate is labelled as a guide, so customers know a final price follows.

features.title: Prices in one file
features.description: Your rates and discounts live in one data file you can change without touching the code.

landingPage.metaDescription: Show cleaning prices upfront with a live quote calculator, transparent room pricing and estimates visitors can share or print. A one-page Hostinger template.
landingPage.short: Cleaning service page with a live, itemized quote calculator.
landingPage.long: A one-page site for a cleaning service: visitors choose rooms and frequency, see an itemized, non-binding price, and share, print or email their quote.
